stageInfo.DOCUMENTS: Upload your electricity bill, Aadhaar, PAN and a cancelled cheque. Our team verifies each one.
stageInfo.SURVEY: Our engineer visits your roof to measure the shadow-free area and cable routes.
stageInfo.QUOTE: We prepare your techno-commercial proposal based on your bill and the site survey.
stageInfo.ADVANCE_PAYMENT: 90% advance confirms your order and starts material procurement.
stageInfo.SUBSIDY_APPLICATION: We file your PM Surya Ghar subsidy application.
stageInfo.INSTALLATION: Panels, inverter and structure are dispatched and installed on your roof.
stageInfo.NET_METERING: We file for net metering with CSPDCL. The 10% balance is due at file submission.
stageInfo.COMMISSIONED: The net meter is installed and your plant is live.
stageInfo.SUBSIDY_CREDITED: The government subsidy reaches your bank account. Your 5-year AMC begins.
